codes.means: the record names no standard, the bare unversioned recurrent URL written before versions, or another kind's standard
codes.fix: recurrent-md migrate <dir> --apply adds or upgrades it; a record naming another kind's standard is not a recurrent, so move or fix it by hand

codes.means: the record names a version of the recurrent standard this validator does not implement
codes.fix: install the recurrent-md version that implements it, or rewrite the record to https://hypercontext.wiki/standards/recurrent/v1

codes.means: kind is missing or is not "recurrent"
codes.fix: recurrent-md migrate <dir> --apply sets kind: recurrent; a record of another kind is not a recurrent, so move or fix it by hand

codes.means: the record still keeps fields as **Label:** lines in its body, which Supersuit reads only when its header lacks the key
codes.fix: recurrent-md migrate <dir> --apply moves them into the header and out of the body

codes.means: there is no Method, so nothing runs: neither a superskill, nor words, nor an unattended command
codes.fix: write the superskill as /namespace:skill, or the words themselves, as method

codes.means: there is no Cadence and no At times, so nothing can say when it is due
codes.fix: set cadence (hourly, every 6 hours, twice daily, daily, every 3 days, weekly, every 2 weeks, monthly), or at for named times

codes.means: the cadence is not one Supersuit can count, so it can never say how overdue the recurrent is
codes.fix: use hourly, every N hours, twice daily, daily, every N days, weekly, every N weeks, fortnightly, monthly or quarterly

codes.means: status is not active or paused, the only words Supersuit writes for a recurrent
codes.fix: set status to active or paused; pause a recurrent rather than retiring it, so its history stays

codes.means: last_run is not a real date written YYYY-MM-DD, or never
codes.fix: set last_run to never, or leave it for the run to write
